This lesson is tailored for professionals or  academics who need to prepare for upcoming interviews and/or presentations in English. Together, we will work on your confidence, vocabulary and question and answer skills. You can expect to improve your professional conversation skills and learn how to hold engaging conversations in a more formal setting.

The focus of the lesson is presentation and interview skills using the English language. How to present with confidence using appropriate language in a business or academic setting will be practised.
